(#{h.id}, #{h.name}, #{h.officialName}, #{h.enName}, #{h.tier}, #{h.winRate}, #{h.pickRate}, #{h.version}, #{h.date}, #{h.winRank})

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, official_name AS officialName, en_name AS enName, tier, win_rate AS winRate, pick_rate AS pickRate, version, date, win_rank AS winRank FROM heroes ORDER BY id

INSERT INTO augments (id, name, en_name, rarity, tier_name, description, tooltip, enabled) VALUES
(#{a.id}, #{a.name}, #{a.enName}, #{a.rarity}, #{a.tierName}, #{a.description}, #{a.tooltip}, #{a.enabled})

INSERT INTO hero_augment_rank (hero_id, augment_id, tier, win_rank, total, win_rate, pick_rate, num_games, num_win_games) VALUES
(#{r.heroId}, #{r.augmentId}, #{r.tier}, #{r.winRank}, #{r.total}, #{r.winRate}, #{r.pickRate}, #{r.numGames}, #{r.numWinGames})

INSERT INTO augment_combos (hero_id, augment_ids, win_rate, pick_rate, num_games, num_win_games, win_rank) VALUES
(#{c.heroId}, #{c.augmentIds}, #{c.winRate}, #{c.pickRate}, #{c.numGames}, #{c.numWinGames}, #{c.winRank})

INSERT INTO items (id, name, en_name, description, plaintext, total_price, base_price, tags, from_ids, into_ids, version) VALUES
(#{it.id}, #{it.name}, #{it.enName}, #{it.description}, #{it.plaintext}, #{it.totalPrice}, #{it.basePrice}, #{it.tags}, #{it.fromIds}, #{it.intoIds}, #{it.version})

INSERT INTO hero_item_build (hero_id, build_index, group_index, slot, item_id, win_rate, pick_rate) VALUES
(#{b.heroId}, #{b.buildIndex}, #{b.groupIndex}, #{b.slot}, #{b.itemId}, #{b.winRate}, #{b.pickRate})

mapper.select: SELECT hero_id AS heroId, build_index AS buildIndex, group_index AS groupIndex, slot, item_id AS itemId, win_rate AS winRate, pick_rate AS pickRate FROM hero_item_build WHERE hero_id = #{heroId} ORDER BY build_index ASC, group_index ASC, slot ASC
